After an unusually long three-week wait, Apple today officially released iOS 27 beta 5, with this update also bringing new app icons to multiple apps including the Siri app and Safari.

Apple rolls out app icon updates with iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to its public release, expected to launch officially next month.

Today's beta 5 brings several user-visible changes in preparation for the official release of the system update.

Among them, several system apps have received new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above. Some other apps also appear to have fairly subtle updates.

Since the first beta version, iOS 27 has already introduced design changes to more icons, as Apple continues to refine last year's Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Apps like Maps, Photos, and Wallet have had new icons since the early stages of iOS 27. But the revisions in this beta 5 show that Apple's adjustments to the iOS 27 icons are not yet finished.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
